verdict.rationale: Galileo captures and tracks latency, cost, and eval-score-like metrics (hallucination, instruction adherence, custom LLM-as-judge metrics) and supports alerting on these signals, and its console UI is referenced for experiments/projects, implying some dashboarding. However, there is no explicit documentation of a customizable dashboard-building feature (e.g., dragging/arranging widgets across metric types) — only underlying metrics, logging, and alert configuration are evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit dashboard-builder UI documentation, ability to combine latency/error/cost/eval metrics into one custom view, and independent confirmation of dashboard customization.
